title: "Shen: A Sufficiently Advanced Lisp" by Aditya Siram
summary: Aditya Siram introduces Shen, a small hosted Lisp with macros, a built-in Prolog and an optional type system. The talk demos a full web app moving between functional, logic and imperative styles, including turning JSON into a type with macros.
why: It is the standard recommended introduction to Shen, pointed to whenever Shen or its type system comes up.

quote.text: @deech's talks, though older now, are fantastic and relevant[1,2].
